name: MvPolynomial.taylor_eq_zero_iff
source:
theorem taylor_eq_zero_iff (α : σ → A) (P : MvPolynomial σ A) : taylor α P = 0 ↔ P = 0 :=
  (taylor_injective α).eq_iff' (map_zero _)
signature: theorem taylor_eq_zero_iff (α : σ → A) (P : MvPolynomial σ A) : taylor α P = 0 ↔ P = 0
what: A translated polynomial vanishes precisely when the original polynomial does.
how: Injectivity from taylor_injective and preservation of zero identify the zero fibers.
hypotheses: A commutative coefficient ring and any translation vector and polynomial.
